changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'SearchBoost') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[SearchBoost]( [Field] [varchar](255) NOT NULL, [Boost] [decimal](5, 2) NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_SEARCHBOOST] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [Field] ASC ) ) END
